Key Findings

Summary

This analysis detected 296.98 km² of deforestation in the study area, representing 0.82% of the total area analyzed.

The analysis was conducted using Landsat time-series data with 3 acquisition dates, employing NDVI and NBR indices for change detection.

Methodology

Data Sources

  • Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance
  • Time series analysis with multiple acquisition dates
  • Spectral indices: NDVI and NBR

Analysis Methods

  • NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index): Measures vegetation health and density
  • NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio): Sensitive to vegetation loss and forest disturbance
  • dNBR (differenced NBR): Primary indicator for deforestation detection
  • Classification: 6-class severity system based on dNBR thresholds
